All 4 mdx-loader failures also pre-exist without my change (unrelated to the fix). 

## Summary

The fix is applied in `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownUtils.ts:157-160` — the `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` regexes only matched LF (`\n`) line endings, so an `mdx-code-block` containing `<Tabs>/<TabItem>` JSX in a CRLF file was never unwrapped into raw MDX, causing the "Expected component `TabItem` to be defined" compilation error. The regexes now use `\r?\n` everywhere (matching the upstream fix in facebook/docusaurus#9897).

Validation:
- `markdownUtils.test.ts`: 93/93 tests pass (includes the `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` suite)
- Manual check: a CRLF `mdx-code-block` containing `<Tabs>/<TabItem>` is now correctly unwrapped with CRLF line endings preserved
- Pre-existing unrelated failures (`globUtils.test.ts` HOME_DIR snapshot, 4 mdx-loader heading tests) fail identically with and without the change
